items.q: How far ahead should I order?
items.a: Give us 48 hours for pastries and two weeks for a custom celebration cake. Wedding cakes are best booked three to six months ahead, as we take a limited number each weekend.
Yes, within our local delivery zone, with the fee shown at checkout. You can also pick your order up from our kitchen at no charge; we send the pickup details once your order is confirmed.
We offer gluten-free and dairy-free options for many of our cakes. Our kitchen handles nuts, gluten, dairy and eggs, so we cannot guarantee that any item is free of traces of them.

items.q: Can I order a custom design?
items.a: Absolutely. Tell us the occasion, the number of guests and any inspiration you have, and we will sketch a design and quote it for you before anything is baked.

items.q: How should I store my pastries?
items.a: Most pastries are best the day they are made. Keep cream-filled pieces and cakes refrigerated, and take them out about 30 minutes before serving so the flavours come through.
